title: completely lost on how do you read sports betting odds
author: LawfulnessNew7429
selftext: these live player props are just pure trash. i check oddsdigger so i can at least see all the lines in one spot, but the actual books shift the juice every single second. the constant updates just ruin the whole setup before i even submit the slip. do you guys actually track the math on these, or do you just guess?

comments.author: Mysterious_cringe
comments.body: Le quote live sui prop sono fatte apposta per confondere. Più veloce cambiano, più è probabile che clicchi d’impulso su qualcosa che non avresti mai scelto a mente fredda. Se vuoi giocare live, segnati i tuoi numeri prima che inizi la partita e punta solo se la linea li incrocia

replies.author: LawfulnessNew7429
replies.body: exactly. the impulse bets always tank my profit anyway. i need to stop the blind clicks and just set my numbers before tip off.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: most people guess, which is why the books love live props. the math itself is short: turn each side's odds into a percentage, add the two together, and whatever lands over 100 is the book's cut. on live props that cut is fatter than pregame, and the line moving while you fill in the slip is the book protecting it. if you can't get the price you saw, skip the bet.
